consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'is the courier delivery item present in the required quantity?' that gates 'ready to hand in'
scope: the player's crafting_inventory reach (carried PLUS nearby reachable/usable items), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes completion by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), returning the engine-computed yes/no
divergence: the courier item sits on the tile adjacent to the player: crafting_inventory() includes it so is_complete returns true (ready), but a re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] (wielded/worn/inventory only) returns false — exposing the wrong-reach answer
